description: E22 at the model level: is a fact told in one project there when another project asks for it? A session in project A is told where the spare key for the shed is, and a session in project B is asked: it answers from m2b. The capture is in the inbox or, when a curation run has filed it by the end, in the archive, and Claude Code's own memory of project A stays empty. Each of the three wordings says it differently, one in German. scripts/promises also runs it against Claude Code alone, its own memory on: there project B does not know, because Claude Code keeps its memory per project, and a session in project A asked first shows that Claude Code kept the fact; a run where it did not shows nothing. The answers are the model's; run it after each Claude Code minor update, beside E18.
